properties.name: text
properties.description: The text to find contact details in: plain text, shown as written (line breaks kept)

properties.name: resolve
properties.description: Supplies details for an address, number, link or handle – details, null for none, or a promise; used when no tc-entity-lookup listener responds

properties.name: trigger
properties.description: What opens a card: "both" (hover, focus and right-click), "hover" (hover and focus) or "contextmenu" (right-click, Menu key, Enter)

properties.name: hoverDelay
properties.description: How long the pointer rests on a mark before its card opens, ms

properties.name: kindLabels
properties.description: What each kind is called on its card, merged over the defaults

properties.name: notFoundText
properties.description: What the card says when the app knows nothing more

properties.name: errorText
properties.description: What the card says when the lookup failed

properties.name: entities
properties.description: The addresses, numbers, links and handles found in `text`, in order

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-entity-lookup
events.description: A card needs details ({ kind, value, text, signal, respondWith }: EntityLookupDetail); cancelable – call respondWith() with the details (or a promise), or prevent it without responding for "nothing more known"

events.name: tc-copy
events.description: Copy was pressed ({ text, kind }: EntityCopyDetail); cancelable – prevent it to copy your own way

events.name: tc-open
events.description: A link in the card is about to open ({ kind, value, url }: EntityOpenDetail); cancelable – prevented, the link doesn't open

events.name: tc-open-change
events.description: A card opened or closed ({ open }: EntityOpenChange; null when closed)

methods.name: clearCache
methods.description: Forgets cached details – one entity's, or all of them – so the next card asks again

methods.name: openCard
methods.description: Opens the card for the entity at `index` in `entities`, pinned open; focus stays where it is

methods.name: closeCard
methods.description: Closes the open card, if any

functions.name: entityKinds
functions.description: Every kind, in the order overlapping matches are settled: a link beats the address inside it

functions.name: defaultEntityKindLabels
functions.description: What each kind is called on its card

functions.name: findEntities
functions.signature: findEntities(text: string, kinds: readonly EntityKind[]): EntityMatch[]
functions.description: Every email address, phone number, link and

functions.name: phoneCountry
functions.description: The country for an international number, from its calling code

props.name: onLookup
props.description: Called when a card needs details; call `detail.respondWith(details | promise)` to answer, or use `resolve` instead

props.name: onCopy
props.description: Called when Copy is pressed; return false to stop the component writing to the clipboard itself

props.name: onOpenLink
props.description: Called before a link in the card opens (Write email, Call, Open, the app's links); return false to handle it yourself

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with what the open card is for, or null when it closed

changelog: **Entity Details** (`tc-entity-details`) – emails, phone numbers, links and @handles in text are found and marked; hover, focus or right-click opens a card with Copy, Write email / Call / Open and what your `resolve` (or a `tc-entity-lookup` listener) knows. **Identifier Details** (`tc-identifier-details`) does the same for DOIs, IP addresses (private and reserved ranges named), file hashes, CVE ids and tracking numbers.

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: inert
features.why: Closed and leaving parts are out of the tab order and hidden from screen readers.

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: Popover API
features.without: Lists open fixed to the window instead of in the top layer, so a clipping ancestor or a modal can cover them.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.
